title: Rights & Responsibilities, Revisited
grammar: Recap: joga van ahhoz, hogy; kötelező, megengedett, tilos
goal: I can say what rights and duties citizens have, with joga van ahhoz, hogy and kötelessége, hogy.
I can say what is mandatory, allowed or forbidden, with kötelező, megengedett and tilos + infinitive.
I can talk about citizens' rights with four new words, such as önkormányzat and jogállamiság.
I can say what a civic duty is.
